_how_to_fill: centerline: [lat, lon] points following the middle of the fjord, FIRST point at the mouth, LAST point at the glacier front. 3-10 points is plenty.
sill_km: distance of the sill crest along the centerline, measured from the first (mouth) point. Casts seaward of this are 'outside'.
H_gl: grounding-line depth at the glacier front [m]. H_sill: sill depth [m].
max_cross_km: how far a cast can be from the centerline and still count as inside the fjord (about half the fjord width).
shelf_km: how far seaward of the mouth to accept 'outside' casts; shelf_cross_km: their allowed distance from the centerline's extension.

Measure them with: python3 make_fjord_entry.py bottom_<fjord>_bedmachine.nc --write (BedMachine; it also saves Plots/<fjord>/fjord_entry_<fjord>.png to check them). shelf_km and shelf_cross_km are defaults to adjust by hand.

ilulissat._note: Measured by make_fjord_entry.py from bottom_ilulissat_large_bedmachine.nc (BedMachine) on 2026-11-02: centerline = thalweg from the box's mouth row to the ice front, cut to 8 points; H_sill = shallowest depth on the deepest route out; sill_km = its crest along the centerline; H_gl = deepest water at the BedMachine ice front; max_cross_km ~ half the fjord width. shelf_km and shelf_cross_km are defaults.
